notes.subject: התקם
notes.rationale: 'hitikemu' — 'o di hlole' (di gogele ka ntle, KJV/ASV) goba 'o di hlole' (YST 'draw them away'); sephephane se bolela kudu ka go roba le go kgoboka ka maatla.

notes.subject: לטבחה...הרגה
notes.rationale: Go hlakanela ga mafoko a mabedi a go bolaia (tevakhah le haregah) a a theilweng godimo ga selo se sengwe se se feletšego.

notes.subject: אתך
notes.rationale: Preposition 'etekha' e tsewa bjalo ka 'le wena'; selo se supilweng ke ⟨את⟩ se rometšwe go latela, go se ke ga ngwalwa ga gabedi.

translation: Gomme wena, Yahwe, o nthweditše; o mpontšhitše, gomme o lekile pelo ya ka ⟨le wena⟩. Di hlole bjalo ka dinku le dipudi bakeng sa go bolaia, gomme o di kgethile bakeng sa letšatši la go bolaya.
